description: This is a test module for FastAPI backend validation gates, utilizing pytest to perform integration tests on validation endpoints. It specifically tests failure cases when validation gates fail and success cases for validation run requests, including assertions on API responses and audit logging behavior.

methods.name: test_run_validation_gate_failure_returns_422_and_audits_failure( client, audit_repo, auth_headers, gate_error_code, gate_name, )
methods.description: Tests that the validation endpoint returns a 422 error and logs an audit when a specific validation gate fails, parameterized over different gate failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_run_validation_success_returns_200_or_202_and_audits_success(client, audit_repo, auth_headers)
methods.description: Tests that a successful validation run returns either 200 or 202 status code, includes a correlation ID, and logs a success audit.
